acceptance_boundary: Metadata-only inventory and exact read through existing ready Conduit Codex app-server hosts; no observation-driven host/process/task/turn/input/slot creation. Complete bounded nonarchived stateDB-only inventory, includeTurns false, exact identity, separate query-host provenance, scoped expiry/cancellation, and preserved driving mappings.

limits.inventory: At most four ready hosts; each complete inventory at most four 64-item pages. No partial success after malformed, duplicate, cyclic or incomplete metadata.
limits.exact_read: One ready host and exact full current inventory membership; no prefix/alias or implicit multi-host selection. Exact returned ID/family/creation and nonregressing updatedAt required.
limits.model: Configured or latest persisted metadata only; per-turn execution and entitlement UNKNOWN.
limits.host: Query host is provider-specific observation_host_id. Canonical worker providerHostID is known only when that exact thread appeared in that host loaded list. All host-loaded observations are time- and host-scoped.
limits.privacy: Preview, title, rollout path, turn content and arbitrary provider payload withheld. Fixed sanitized errors do not echo rejected metadata or provider error text.
limits.rpc: Only conduit.observation.v1/ string namespace bypasses driving mapper. This does not certify generic numeric RPC authority, unrelated notifications or malformed unclassifiable transport.
limits.authority: Observation grants no writer, adoption, lifecycle or objective acceptance authority.
